is: The typed model of ZAF.toml: one struct per section with the pack's defaults, the [requires] version pins, and the loader that defaults and validates the whole document.
conventions: Each ZAF.toml table maps to a *Section struct in sections.rs; every fixed section denies unknown keys, [check.<target>] is an open table
Keys a kind needs (repo for github-issues and github, repo or path for design, image for container) are checked at load in Manifest::validate

fs.name: requirement.rs
fs.role: [requires]: semver requirement or pinned release tag

fs.name: sections.rs
fs.role: every section, its kinds and defaults

notes: Only [project] and [board] are required; vcs, forge, gate, style and pack are optional and design defaults to kind none
Sections: project, requires, board, vcs, forge, design, style, workspaces, branches, gate, runners, roles, check, ask, spawn, isolation, pack, forbidden, phases
[phases] maps a task type's name to its ordered list of action names; the load refuses an empty list and a name listed twice, and a higher layer replaces a type's whole list
isolation kind container parses and validates, but no adapter acts on it

Board kind forgejo-issues needs url and repo; token_env names the variable holding the token (FORGEJO_TOKEN by default), never the token. Forge kind forgejo parses with the same keys, but composing it is CompositionError::NotBuilt

Machine-private .zaf/local.toml is the top layer (layers.rs local_layer): only [spawn] slots and [gate] slot reach the manifest, any other setting is ManifestError::LocalSetting; its [budget], [report.prices] and [auth] tables are dropped here and read by their own readers
